title: Sri Lanka Hospitality Graduates Association holds 55th Annual General Meeting | Daily FT
summary:
Thursday, 5 November 2026 12:59
-     - 11

The new Executive Committee of the Sri Lanka Hospitality Graduates Association

Dr. Gitanjali Chakravarthy re-elected as President for a second term

The Sri Lanka Hospitality Graduates Association (SLHGA) successfully concluded its 55th Annual General Meeting (AGM), held from 16 to 18 October 2026 at Araliya Beach Resort and Spa, Unawatuna, bringing together hospitality professionals, industry leaders and members from across Sri Lanka.

Held under the theme “Connect • Collaborate • Celebrate,” the three-day gathering celebrated professional fellowship, industry collaboration and the Association’s longstanding contribution to Sri Lanka’s hospitality sector.

A key highlight of this year’s AGM was the re-election of Dr. Gitanjali Chakravarthy as President of SLHGA for a second consecutive term. As the first woman to hold the prestigious position of President in the Association’s history, Dr. Chakravarthy continues to mark an important milestone in its leadership.

Her re-election reflects the confidence placed in her leadership as the Association continues its commitment to professional development, industry engagement and strengthening Sri Lanka’s hospitality fraternity.

The 55th Annual General Meeting also marked the appointment of the new Executive Committee, entrusted with guiding the Association’s activities, strengthening its professional network and advancing its objectives.

The following members were appointed to the key office-bearing positions:

President: Dr. Gitanjali Chakravarthy

Vice President 1: Dinesh Hettiarachchi

Vice President 2: Thakshila Galappaththy

Immediate Past President: Patrick G.S. Pereira

General Secretary: Kanishka Udawatta

Treasurer: Pradeep Liyanage

Together with the newly appointed Executive Committee members, the office bearers will focus on strengthening the Association’s governance, promoting professional excellence, enhancing membership engagement and supporting initiatives that contribute to the advancement of Sri Lanka’s hospitality industry.

The three-day AGM provided an exceptional platform for members to reconnect with industry colleagues, strengthen professional relationships and celebrate their shared passion for hospitality.

Beyond the formal AGM proceedings, the program featured networking opportunities, entertainment, culinary experiences, recreational activities and family-oriented events, creating a memorable gathering for members and their families.

The event was organised under the leadership of Vice President and Chairperson of the AGM Organising CommitteeDinesh Hettiarachchi, with the guidance and support of Former President and Advisor to the AGM Committee Priyal Pereira.

Their leadership, together with the dedication of the organising committee, contributed significantly to the successful execution of the Association’s 55th AGM.

SLHGA also extended its appreciation to the management and team of Araliya Beach Resort and Spa, Unawatuna, for their cooperation, hospitality and support throughout the event.

With a proud legacy spanning more than five decades, the Sri Lanka Hospitality Graduates Association remains one of the country’s respected professional associations representing the hospitality fraternity.

As the Association enters another chapter under the leadership of Dr. Gitanjali Chakravarthy and the newly appointed Executive Committee, SLHGA remains committed to fostering professional collaboration, supporting future hospitality leaders and creating opportunities for its members.
